about: src/lib/business_date_vectors.json is a byte-for-byte copy of madar-shared's file at this ref (the backend and the POS core run the same rule from madar-time business_date_of). The ref is a commit sha, not a tag, until the next madar-shared tag; then move it to that tag. A change is made there, released with a tag, and copied here with the tag and hash below updated; scripts/check-shared-vectors.sh (CI) and shared_vectors.test.ts check it, and lib/madar-time.test.ts runs lib/format.ts cairoParts and features/staff/util.ts isoDaysFromToday against it.
